summary: Release-readiness is blocked by unapplied database migration status. Passed checks: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; full source suite `node --test ...` with 28/28 passing; and final production build `npm.cmd run build`, which completed successfully and generated routes including `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/feedback-request`, and `/feedback/[identifier]`. Blocker command: `npx.cmd prisma migrate status`. Error/evidence: exit code 1; Prisma found 5 migrations and reported `Following migration have not yet been applied: 20260915100000_feedback_request_batch_upload`. Per instruction, I did not deploy or run `prisma migrate deploy`. Browser verification, Playwright/e2e, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email/customer contact were not run.
